commit.message:
test(#1342 r5): phep do khang thoat job - J4 breakaway tuong minh, J5 breakaway ngam, J12 job long, S6 fixture mo rong

Bac r1d-a1-ii cua WP1174-WINDOWS-BACKEND, dac ta r5 (sha256 0550af21...).
Chi THEM vao .claude/dev/packet_loop_test.py; packet_loop.py giu nguyen byte.

- M1: _wp1342a1ii_FX = _wp1342a1_FX + ba nhanh elif moi (tach, vao_job,
  tro_c); moi buoc luon de lai tep ket qua (ghi tam + os.replace). Phia test:
  doc tep co han + kiem schema, han chung 75 s moi ca, cho THO
  WaitForSingleObject, phep cham thu hoi dung 5000 ms.
- M2 J4: doi chung (ii) di chinh duong san pham tu chinh tien trinh chay ca,
  ban nap module rieng voi LimitFlags cho phep breakaway; phan loai theo thu tu.
- M3 J5: IsProcessInJob(chau, job dich) khi chau con song, con chua thoat.
- M4 J12: tro giup tu vao job ngoai roi chay _1174_win_spawn_job; nhanh (B)
  hoac (C), kiem job ngoai con mo truoc moi phep cham va trong finally.
- M5 S6 (moi nen), M6 dang ky 4 ca sau dang ky r4.

Da do tren Linux: S6, N2 (bo kiem r4 sau sed), ruff F, f1/f2.
CHUA DO tren Windows: J4, J5, J12 va dot bien e1/e2/e1c/a1@J12 (ca native
BO QUA tren Linux) - phien dieu phoi do tren Desktop.
